notes.title: THE GOOD OLD DAYS Demo Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We hope you're all enjoying the demo for THE GOOD OLD DAYS!

The current demo has been updated as of today.
Please take a look at the update details below.

[h2]November 5th, 2024 Patch Note[/h2]
[h3]Feature Adjustments / Additions[/h3] 
[list]  
[*] Added an option to select key operation patterns in the settings menu. 
[*] Adjusted so that events will be triggered by pressing the Up key. 
[*] Assigned the swim command to the same button as jump. 
[*] Adjusted the screen to scroll slightly downward when crouching. 
[*] Added the ability to move the map when zoomed in on the map menu. 
[*] Enhanced the visibility of vines that players can cling to and move along. 
[/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3] 
[list] 
[*] Fixed an issue where changes made in game settings were not being saved. [/list]
We've created a dedicated thread in the community for collecting your feedback and impressions!
We would greatly appreciate it if you try the demo version and share your honest opinions with us!

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2996540/discussions/0/4699035108381454889/][Share your feedback and impressions on the DEMO version here][/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2996540/discussions/0/4699035108381469566/][Report any bugs in the DEMO version here][/url]

We will use the feedback we receive to make improvements and adjustments to the content.
Please help us make THE GOOD OLD DAYS an even better game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2996540/THE_GOOD_OLD_DAYS/

We hope you'll continue to support THE GOOD OLD DAYS!

notes.title: THE GOOD OLD DAYS Next Fest Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The October edition of Steam Next Fest has officially begun!🎉
This time around, the nostalgic metroidvania from way back in the day, “THE GOOD OLD DAYS” will be featured as a playable demo!

[h3]📮THE GOOD OLD DAYS - Game Introduction[/h3]

[b]”The days we can’t get back shine the brightest”[/b]

Set in the rural town of Arostia in the year 19XX, young go-getter Sean and his ensemble of like-minded buddies band together to form The Noogies, a hopeful gang that dream of one day striking it out on a real adventure together. 

On one most frightful occasion returning home, Sean is confronted by a dastardly loan shark lying in wait. 

The loan shark reveals he has imprisoned Sean’s friends and makes a ludicrous demand that outstanding debts left by his absent father must be repaid in full by the end of the day… 

Despite the precarious situation, a burst of excitement erupts within Sean. Finally! 

The opportunity for a true adventure! Will Sean be able to save his friends and repay the debt!?

[h3]💣Objectives[/h3]
You can clear the game successfully by repaying the debt within the time limit.
The objective of this demo version is to collect $30,000, and the expected play time to complete the game is from 1 to 2 hours.

[h3]🔑Game Clear Conditions[/h3]
Raise money and pay off your debts in a variety of ways!
Many ways to make money exist.

For example...
・Uncover the money hidden throughout the map
・Play minigames
・Try your hand at the lottery
・Defeat bosses and collect the money prize
・Clear high difficulty “trials”
…and more!

There are even more ways to earn money, so explore the dungeons and discover them for yourself!

[h3]💡Known Bugs[/h3]
Currently, we have confirmed the following bugs:

・When saving at a save point (post), the game is not recorded correctly.

We apologize for the inconvenience this may cause and ask for your patience until the problem is resolved.

If you have any feedback or comments, please feel free to post them to the Steam community or as comments on THE GOOD OLD DAYS official X!
Be sure to add to your Wishlist so you can receive all the latest news, too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2996540/THE_GOOD_OLD_DAYS/

Thank you for reading this far.
We appreciate your continued support of "THE GOOD OLD DAYS."
